enriched.title: Relato Diário: Problemas com VPN e Vocabulário Técnico
enriched.summary: A aula focou na prática de relatar eventos diários no passado, como problemas com VPNs, enquanto reforçava a gramática do Simple Past. Também foram exploradas palavras técnicas relacionadas à tecnologia e expressões úteis.
mainTopics: Vocabulário técnico sobre VPNs e TI

vocabulary.definition: A Virtual Private Network (VPN) is a technology that creates a secure and encrypted connection over a less secure network, such as the internet.
examples: I need to activate my VPN when I connect to Microsoft’s intranet.

vocabulary.definition: To set up or arrange something, especially computer systems or software.
examples: Today, I needed to configure a new VPN for my customer.

vocabulary.definition: A situation in which two or more things are not compatible or are in opposition.
A private network accessible only to an organization's staff.
examples: I need to activate my VPN when I connect to Microsoft’s intranet.

vocabulary.definition: To make something active or operative.
examples: I need to activate my VPN when I connect to Microsoft’s intranet.

grammar.explanation: The Simple Past is used to describe actions that were completed in the past.
rules: Add '-ed' to regular verbs for the past form (e.g., 'work' → 'worked').
Use the second form of irregular verbs (e.g., 'go' → 'went').
Use 'didn't' + base verb for negatives (e.g., 'I didn't work').
examples: I had a big problem with my VPN.
commonMistakes: Using the base form instead of the past tense (e.g., 'I work yesterday' instead of 'I worked yesterday').
Forgetting to use 'did' in negative sentences (e.g., 'I not work' instead of 'I didn’t work').

expressions.expression: tell you how my day was
expressions.meaning: explicar ou relatar como foi o meu dia
expressions.usage: Usado para introduzir um relato sobre eventos passados.
examples: I will try to tell you how my day was.

practiceQuestions.question: Transform the sentence into the negative form: 'I worked on the new VPN today.'
practiceQuestions.answer: I didn’t work on the new VPN today.
practiceQuestions.explanation: In the Simple Past, use 'didn't' followed by the base form of the verb.

practiceQuestions.question: Choose the correct sentence: a) I didn’t worked. b) I didn’t work.
practiceQuestions.explanation: In negative sentences in the Simple Past, use 'didn't' + base verb.

culturalNotes: VPNs are commonly used in corporate environments to ensure secure connections when accessing private company networks remotely.
Microsoft’s intranet is an example of a private network used by a specific organization.
studyTips: Practice using the Simple Past by writing a short paragraph about your day.
Familiarize yourself with technical vocabulary by reading articles or watching videos related to IT and VPNs.
originalExamples: I will try to tell you how my day was. (Eu vou tentar contar como foi o meu dia.)
I had a big problem with my VPN. (Eu tive um grande problema com a minha VPN.)
I need to activate my VPN when I connect to Microsoft’s intranet. (Eu preciso ativar minha VPN quando me conecto à intranet da Microsoft.)
Today, I needed to configure a new VPN for my customer. (Hoje, eu precisei configurar uma nova VPN para meu cliente.)
The VPNs created conflicting IPs. (As VPNs criaram IPs conflitantes.)
So I didn’t work. (Então eu não trabalhei.)
